summary: Retire EKODI Money's public Money subdomain identity and enforce ekodi.kr/money as the user-facing canonical route while preserving provider-independent internal Workers and service-binding execution.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly directed EKODI to stop using EKODI subdomains, use apex path routing as the default, enforce the rule across subservices, and continue implementation through completion.
implementation: remove Money from governance legacy-domain allowlist and legacy canonical-host mapping
make https://ekodi.kr/money the service-manifest, auth-return, admin-directory and monitoring address
remove the production Money custom-domain route and retain only the technical Workers execution URL for candidate verification
route /money through the Shared Site MONEY service binding
strengthen KFTC Open Banking activation so contract, canonical OAuth redirect, replay-safe state, token encryption, consent storage, approved read scopes and a server-side adapter are all required
limit Money to a read-only Finance banking health bridge; account data and financial execution remain outside this bridge
mandatoryRules: EKODI Money user-facing entry is https://ekodi.kr/money
Money must not recreate a public EKODI subdomain
technical workers.dev endpoints are candidate/runtime infrastructure only and are not user-facing canonical addresses
KFTC Open Banking read access remains disabled until every declared readiness gate and server-side adapter are present
Money autonomous financial execution remains false
Finance transfer execution remains separately fail-closed unless its reviewed executor and human-confirmation gates are enabled
rollback: Restore the previous Money Worker version and canonical /money service-binding release while keeping real bank reads and transfers disabled; do not restore the retired public Money subdomain without a new owner-approved constitutional amendment.
